messages.subject: stacked occuMulti in unmarked
parts:
Dear all,

Recent updates to the unmarked package now allow for the inclusion of random effects in some models. However, it is still not possible to include random effects in occuMulti (the Rota et al. 2016 model).
Do you have any ideas/insights on how to fit this model on data stacked by site x season?

Thank you in advance for any comment.

Best,

Luca
